key_insight: Yb₃Pd₄Bi₈ is a metallic Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈-type compound with nonmagnetic divalent Yb and predicted symmetry-enforced Dirac points at the Fermi level.
engineering_relevance: The compound provides a platform for exploring symmetry-protected electronic states and designing rare-earth analogs within this structural family.
method: Single-crystal growth and X-ray structure determination
First-principles electronic-structure calculations including spin–orbit coupling
evidence_signal: Measurements show nearly isotropic diamagnetism and metallic transport, while calculations predict four nodal lines crossing the Fermi level and a Fermi-level density of states within 1% of Ca₃Pd₄Bi₈.
watch_item: The predicted nodal lines and Dirac points require direct experimental verification.
paper_title: Divalent Yb in the Ca$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$ Structure Type: Crystal Growth and Physical Properties of Yb$_3$Pd$_4$Bi$_8$
